name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
target_qualification: Class 12th passed students pursuing regular graduation (Engineering, Medicine, Arts, Science, Commerce)
eligibility: Students above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in relevant stream from respective State/Central Examination Board (CBSE/ICSE/State Board). Regular full-time mode only.
income_criteria: Gross family income must not exceed Rs 4.50 Lakhs per annum.
amount: Rs 12,000 per annum for first 3 years of Graduation; Rs 20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level.
application_window: August to November on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by competent government authority (Tahsildar / Revenue Officer)
Bonafide Student Certificate from College / University
Bank Account Passbook copy with IFSC code

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
target_qualification: Female students admitted into 1st year or 2nd year (via Lateral Entry) of AICTE-approved B.Tech or Polytechnic Diploma courses
eligibility: Maximum two girl children per family. Must be admitted to AICTE approved technical institution through centralized state counselling.
income_criteria: Family income not exceeding Rs 8.00 Lakhs per annum.
amount: Rs 50,000 per annum for every year of study (credited directly via DBT) to cover college fee, books, equipment, laptops.
application_window: September to December annually via National Scholarship Portal
required_documents: Allotment letter issued by Centralized Counselling Authority
Annual family income certificate in prescribed format

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
target_qualification: Specially-abled students pursuing Technical Degree (B.Tech) or Diploma in AICTE approved institutions
eligibility: Disability percentage of not less than 40% certified by competent medical authority. Admitted through centralized merit process.
income_criteria: Family income not exceeding Rs 8.00 Lakhs per annum.
amount: Rs 50,000 per annum for each year of duration of the course.
application_window: September to December on NSP portal
required_documents: Disability Certificate from Government Medical Board

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India
target_qualification: Undergraduate students pursuing B.Sc / BS / Integrated M.Sc in Basic and Natural Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Geology, Statistics)
eligibility: Top 1% ranking in Class 12th Board Examinations OR rank within top 10,000 in JEE Main / JEE Advanced / NEET UG pursuing pure sciences.
amount: Total scholarship value of Rs 80,000 per annum (Rs 60,000 cash grant + Rs 20,000 summer research mentorship project component).
application_window: November to January on INSPIRE web portal
required_documents: Endorsement Form signed by Principal/Director of College

name: Prime Minister's Special Scholarship Scheme (PMSSS) for J&K and Ladakh
target_qualification: 12th pass students from UTs of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh pursuing General Degree, Professional (B.Tech/Pharmacy/Nursing), or Medical programs outside the UTs
eligibility: Domicile of J&K or Ladakh, passed 10+2 from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools in J&K/Ladakh.
income_criteria: Family income not exceeding Rs 8.00 Lakhs per annum.
amount: Academic fee up to Rs 1.25 Lakhs (Engineering) or Rs 3.00 Lakhs (Medical) + Maintenance allowance of Rs 1.00 Lakh per annum.

name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC / ST / OBC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs (Implemented via State Portals)
target_qualification: Post-Matriculation or Post-Secondary courses in recognized institutions (Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, PG)
eligibility: Belonging to SC, ST, or OBC categories studying in recognized government or private institutions.
income_criteria: Family income ceiling of Rs 2.50 Lakhs per annum.
amount: 100% compulsory non-refundable college fees reimbursed + Monthly maintenance allowance as per course group.

name: State ePASS & Fee Reimbursement Schemes (AP & Telangana)
provider: Departments of Social Welfare & Backward Classes, AP & TS State Governments
target_qualification: Intermediate, Polytechnic Diploma, B.Tech, B.Pharm, Degree, MBA, MCA courses
eligibility: Students allotted through centralized state counselling (POLYCET, EAPCET, ECET, ICET) in eligible colleges.
income_criteria: Non-creamy layer / White Ration Card holders (Income ceiling Rs 2 Lakhs to Rs 2.5 Lakhs).
amount: Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement to colleges + Vasathi Deevena / Maintenance hostel grant directly into student/mother's bank account.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate & Postgraduate Scholarships
target_qualification: 1st year students enrolled in any full-time undergraduate degree program in India
eligibility: Minimum 60% in Class 12th Board exams. Selection through an online aptitude test.
income_criteria: Household income up to Rs 15 Lakhs (Preference given to under Rs 2.5 Lakhs).
amount: Up to Rs 2 Lakhs total grant for UG degree; Up to Rs 6 Lakhs for PG in Artificial Intelligence & Computer Science.
